description.value:
Effect the first ally to act on your sequenced order gains +1 circumstance to their attack roll; the second gains +2; the third and any thereafter also gain +2 (Blooded-tier cap)

A sequenced attack order builds a cumulative bonus.

cinderfall.incomplete: Sequenced allies get +1/+2/+2(cap) circumstance to their attack rolls in turn. Same "no companion, bare ally bonus" gap as eyes-up/on-my-mark/redline-all-hands.
